$comment: The publishing gate. `auto` rules are enforced by tools/check.mjs and fail the build; `human` rules cannot be verified from a repository and are the reason a gate sits in front of publishing rather than a post-publish apology.

rules.rule: The required Associates sentence appears, unaltered, on every page.
rules.text_required: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
rules.check: every generated .html contains the sentence in the pre-content disclosure strip
rules.why: §5 makes a violation a material breach, not a nit.

rules.rule: The disclosure is repeated in the footer, so a reader who lands at the bottom of a long page still sees it.
rules.check: footer block contains the sentence and a link to the disclosure page
rules.source: SRC-01 §5; SRC-04 (clear and conspicuous); operator brief
rules.why: 'Conspicuous' survives scrolling only if it is placed twice.

rules.rule: Every outbound link to a store carries a link-level label in the same sentence or block, using Amazon's own example wording.
rules.label: (paid link)
rules.check: each a[href*='amzn.to'], a[href*='amazon.'] element must be preceded or followed by a .paid-label node
rules.why: Amazon's FAQ distinguishes the site-wide sentence from the label that sits next to the link.

rules.rule: Every populated cell in a data table resolves to a source id; unverified values stay blank and carry an unverified marker.
rules.check: data rows are JSON; each non-blank field must have a matching src key present in data/sources.json
rules.why: Makes 'never infer' a build failure instead of a promise.

rules.rule: Store links are marked sponsored, never routed through a redirect or an interstitial, and always carry the tag parameter.
rules.check: rel must contain 'sponsored'; no href may point at this site's own outbound-redirect handler; tag= must be present
rules.source: SRC-16 (sponsored); SRC-02 §2(e) (Redirecting Links disqualify); SRC-01 §1 (tagged formats)
rules.why: An intermediate hop both disqualifies the sale and obscures the destination.

rules.rule: No price, availability, star rating or review text is displayed anywhere unless it came from Creators/PA API output or an Amazon-served link, and is timestamped.
rules.check: regex scan of generated HTML for currency patterns, 'out of 5', 'stars', and rating decimals; allowlist requires a provenance key
rules.why: This is the single most common way a compliant-looking affiliate site becomes a non-compliant one.

rules.rule: No claim of superiority, ranking, 'best', or test outcome about a product we have not examined.
rules.check: superlative scan + reviewer sign-off line on each guide
rules.source: SRC-02 §2(b) (no inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims); SRC-08 (headings must not exaggerate)
rules.why: Also the difference between a publication and a content farm.

rules.rule: No price-tracking or price-alert functionality on the site.
rules.check: no form, script or data file may declare a drop-alert/watch feature
rules.why: The brief's wishlist of automation collides with this line; we do not build it.

rules.rule: No incentive, reward, raffle or 'support us' perk tied to clicking a store link.
rules.check: reviewer question in the publishing template
rules.why: Rewards for clicking are explicitly excluded, including donations and points.

rules.rule: Click measurement is aggregate-only: no per-visitor sub-tag assignment, no synthetic clicks, no bot traffic.
rules.check: collector must not write a per-user identifier into any tag/subtag field; no automated click emulation in tooling
rules.why: Analytics ambition is exactly where these two lines get crossed by accident.

rules.rule: No program content is fed to model training or fine-tuning without prior written Amazon approval.
rules.check: data-pipeline review at intake; recorded in the AI-pipeline note
rules.why: It bounds the 'AI-powered platform' ambition: generation is fine, ingest-as-training-data is a separate permission.

rules.rule: Program Content that disappears from Amazon is removed promptly; every product field carries a re-check due date.
rules.check: products with checked_on older than 30 days fail the build with a remove-or-recheck notice
rules.why: Turns a contractual duty into a scheduled job that cannot be quietly ignored.

rules.rule: Store links live only on this site; no Special Links inside an RSS item body, no links in email unless the recipient solicited them, nothing offline.
rules.check: feed.xml must not contain an amazon host in <description>; confirmed at build time
rules.why: The feed is syndicated into mailers by third parties we do not control; the safe design is to feed headlines and link to the guide.

rules.rule: No pop-ups, layer ads or transitional pages; no framing of a store page.
rules.check: no iframe to a store host; newsletter capture is inline, not a modal
rules.why: It also happens to be the reader-friendly choice.

rules.rule: Every internal link resolves to a file we generate; every source URL cited is present in the source register.
rules.check: link crawl of all generated HTML + host allowlist for cited sources
rules.why: A 404 on a 'verify this' link is worse than no link.
